title: Community solar co-op: site visit notes
text: Notes from the site visit to the community solar cooperative on the old landfill. The array has 1,200 panels on fixed ground mounts and feeds a shared meter that splits credits between 140 member households. Members asked how winter output compares with summer; the operator expects roughly a quarter of the July yield in December. For questions about membership, contact the coordinator at alex.morgan@example.com or call (555) 014-2290. Maintenance requests go to field-team@example.org, and the emergency line is +1 555 019 7731. The next open day is planned for the spring, when the new battery cabinet should be commissioned and visitors can see the inverter room.
